# Nextchem (MAIRE) has been selected to provide the technology package for SABIC AN’s "SAN-7" large-scale fertilizer complex in Saudi Arabia based on its NX STAMI™ Urea solution, for a total value of €125 million
PUBLICATION DATE14 Sep, 2026SHARE

_Milan, 14 September 2026_ – **MAIRE (MAIRE.MI)** announces that **Nextchem**, through its nitrogen technology licensor **Stamicarbon**, has been selected to provide the technology package for **Saudi Basic Industries Corporation Agri-Nutrients (SABIC AN)**’s “SAN-7” large-scale fertilizer project located in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia.
